comment: Student plan going from $5.99 to $6.99 is annoying but it's still the cheapest way to get ad-free music. I'm not going anywhere, just wish they'd kept it at six bucks.
That's it, I'm moving to Apple Music. I was already annoyed with the app redesign and now they're charging more for it.
If this actually leads to artists getting paid more I'd be happy with a dollar, but Spotify has promised that before. I'll wait and see.
I mostly use it for podcasts and audiobooks anyway so a dollar isn't going to change anything for me.
Duo going up two bucks split between two people is fine. It's still cheaper than two individual plans so we're staying.
Family at $21.99 for six accounts is still a steal, but I'm tired of every subscription going up every year. Just once I'd like a price to stay put.
I'm on free so this doesn't affect me. The ads still suck though.
Paying more and still no lossless? Tidal has had it forever. This is the part that really gets me.
Everything costs more now, so a dollar a month is about what I expected. Not thrilled but it's fine.
Dropping from Duo to Individual because the Duo increase hurts more than I thought it would. Money is tight and every dollar counts right now.
At this point I just go back to downloading things. Spotify keeps raising prices and I'm done paying for music that I don't even own.
I've been on YouTube Music Premium since it came bundled with YouTube. Spotify raising prices makes it an easy decision to move.
Been a Premium subscriber since 2013. A dollar more is fine by me, and Spotify still has the best recommendations, so I'm not switching.
Spotify is posting record profits and still raising prices on the people who pay them. Pure greed, plain and simple.
Artists are getting a fraction of a cent per stream. If this price bump actually reached them I'd gladly pay it, but I doubt it will.
The app redesign has been bad and now they want more money for it. Features keep getting moved or removed, it's frustrating.
Done. Moving to Tidal for the lossless audio and it'll cost about the same. Should have done it a while ago.
Amazon Music Unlimited is cheaper for Prime members and I already pay for Prime. Switching over this weekend.
Meh. The price went up, I still use it every day, and it's not a big deal to me.
Spotify keeps throwing money at Rogan and other podcast deals. I'd rather they put that toward the music and the people making it.
We're dropping Family. Two kids and everything keeps getting more expensive, so we're going to free for now.
Price hike noted, got the email. Nothing else to add.
Still the cheapest way to get ad-free music with podcasts included. Happy to pay for it.
Apple Music already costs $10.99 and has lossless audio. Goodbye Spotify, I'm not paying more for less.
Free tier with ads is fine for me. I'm not paying for Premium at these prices anymore.
Gonna message support to complain, and then I'll probably stay because all my playlists are here. Annoying but not worth the hassle of moving.
I'd rather pay a dollar more than deal with a worse app somewhere else. Keeping Premium.
Netflix, Disney and YouTube all raised prices this year. Spotify was honestly late to the party, so this doesn't surprise me.
